title: Learning to bin: differentiable and Bayesian optimization for multi-dimensional discriminants in high-energy physics
abstract: arXiv:2601.07756v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Categorizing events using discriminant observables is central to many high-energy physics analyses. Yet, bin boundaries are often chosen manually. A simple, popular choice in multi-classification tasks is to assign events according to the largest per-class score ("argmax") and to apply equidistant binning to the resulting one-dimensional discriminants. We propose a binning optimization for signal significance directly in multi-dimensional discriminants. We use a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to define flexible regions in the score space, which can be interpreted either as bins or as analysis categories. While this GMM-based strategy is applicable in both one and multiple dimensions, we also study a direct bin-boundary optimization in one dimension as a simpler alternative for binary discriminants. translated_title: 学习分箱：高能物理中多维判别量的可微分与贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 利用判别观测量对事件进行分类是许多高能物理分析的核心环节。然而，分箱边界通常需要手动选择。在多分类任务中，一个简单而流行的做法是根据每类得分中的最大值（"argmax"）来分配事件，并对所得到的一维判别量采用等间距分箱。我们提出了一种直接在多维判别量上针对信号显著性进行分箱优化的方法。我们使用高斯混合模型（GMM）在得分空间中定义灵活的区域，这些区域既可以被解释为分箱，也可以被解释为分析类别。虽然这种基于GMM的策略在一维和多维情况下均适用，我们还研究了针对二分类判别量的一种更简单的一维分箱边界直接优化替代方案。在该分箱模型上，我们研究了两种优化策略：可微分优化方法和贝叶斯优化方法。我们研究了两个玩具（摘要不完整）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯混合模型的多维判别量分箱优化方法，通过可微分优化和贝叶斯优化两种策略直接针对信号显著性进行优化，取代了传统手动选择分箱边界的做法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Gaussian Mixture Model-based binning optimization for multi-dimensional discriminants in high-energy physics, employing differentiable and Bayesian optimization strategies to directly maximize signal significance, replacing manual bin boundary selection.
